title: Quantifying Social Biases Using Templates is Unreliable

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model predictions for templates containing male versus female noun phrases, specifically measuring differences in sentiment analysis scores, deviations from neutrality in Natural Language Inference (NLI), and log probability bias scores in Masked Language Modeling (MLM).

Measuring unintended bias in toxicity detection by calculating the False Positive Equality Difference (FPED) and False Negative Equality Difference (FNED) across various demographic identity terms using populated templates.
